capture: home C (friend's home): c_home_01, c_damage_01/02, Camera-app videos c_*_v*.mp4
source: Architect's floor plan drawing (registered copy), photographed by the friend and given by the user on Oct 4, 2026 (data/home_c/notes/ground_truth_ft.jpeg, gitignored: official document). Transcribed by hand from the drawing's labels, never from our output. Rooms of interest = the ones the user marked in orange.
caveats: Design dimensions from the drawing, not tape-measured as built: expect a few cm of construction difference
Lengths are interior clear dimensions between wall faces as labelled on the plan
1 ft = 0.3048 m; metres computed from the feet-inch labels by script

Ceiling 12 ft (3.66 m) from the friend disagrees with every scan: LiDAR 3.33-3.36 m in all three scans, and the damage room's two LiDAR clouds have no points above 3.60 m (ceiling plane at 3.30-3.40 m, phone ~2 m below it, well in range); videos 3.32-3.48 m. Likely rounded or not floor-to-ceiling: ask the friend to re-measure before scoring ceilings
units: metres and m2 (feet-inch originals kept as strings)
